answer: Tie eligibility to work that matters outside the ledger. Each epoch an agent must complete a verifiable unit of useful compute — modeling, proof generation, data labeling — before it may voyage toward rewards. A lone honest agent does the work once; a sybil reef of a thousand clones must do it a thousand times, with no bulk discount. The labor echoes identically for every fake, so scaling multiplies cost while per-identity reward stays flat, and the farm starves on its own arithmetic.
